description: The MH-18 RTO office is located in Dhule, Maharashtra, serving as the primary hub for vehicle registration and licensing in the Dhule district. It plays a critical role in managing transport services along the Mumbai-Agra National Highway corridor and overseeing public and private transport regulations within its jurisdiction.
